title: TRUST Finding
description: Canonical schema for a single finding emitted by any TRUST specialist agent. See references/FINDING_FORMAT.md for field-by-field rules.

agent.description: The agent that emitted the finding. Must match the agent_id from metadata.

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier. Format: <DOMAIN-PREFIX>-<3-DIGITS>, e.g. SEC-007, PERF-012.

rule_source.description: Path to the grounding section that justifies the rule. Format: <source-id>:<path>#<anchor>

file.description: Relative path from the repo root, using forward slashes.

line_start.description: First line of the violation in the new (post-change) version of the file. 1-indexed.

line_end.description: Last line of the violation, inclusive. Equal to line_start for single-line findings.

severity.description: Impact level. See FINDING_FORMAT.md for calibration.

confidence.description: Confidence in the finding. Must be >= 0.80 to be emitted; lower values get silenced.

claim.description: Factual one-sentence description of the violation. No hedging.

evidence_quote.description: LITERAL code from the diff. Caractere-a-caractere. Never paraphrased.

why_it_matters.description: Concrete consequence in THIS project's context. Must reference the rule_source explicitly.

suggestion.description: Proposed fix. Code example preferred. Must respect other project conventions.

false_positive_risk.description: Honest assessment of when this finding could be wrong.

false_positive_reason.description: Required if false_positive_risk is medium or high. Explains what circumstance would invalidate the finding. Null only if risk is low.

examples.claim: User input concatenated directly into SQL query — classic SQL injection.
examples.evidence_quote: const result = await db.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE email='${email}'`);
examples.why_it_matters: Per 06-security-policy.md#input-validation, this project requires parameterized queries in 100% of DB access. This line allows trivial SQLi against the user lookup endpoint.
examples.suggestion: const result = await db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1', [email]);
